HOLISTIC-REVIEW FINDINGS (opus audit, 2026-06-03):

I1 — DECOMPOSE the single atomic MQ-6 into 3 landable increments (MQ-3 already decoupled the invariant test from live state via dual-mode, so the original atomicity rationale is partly obsolete; ordering invariant is still honored):
  * MQ-6a (live infra flip, REVERSIBLE): provision merge_queue rule; reconcile required-checks.txt (drop check-staged-head, KEEP check-staged-head.yml briefly so the context can still report); re-provision. Only step with a clean rollback (de-provision merge_queue -> dual-mode invariant test fails-closed to two-tier).
  * MQ-6b (enforce flip): flip review-coverage-invariant + dangling-references to enforce + add to required-checks.txt, ONLY after 6a has baked and they report green on real merge_group candidates.
  * MQ-6c (dead-code contraction, pure deletion): delete check-staged-head.yml, staged-* ruleset, two-tier test/preflight branches, retire create-sprint-draft-pr.sh, delete orchestrator phases.

I2 — Write the explicit ROLLBACK runbook into MQ-6a: de-provision merge_queue rule -> set dso.merge_queue.enabled=false (MQ-4 flag-OFF is byte-invariant, verified) -> confirm two-tier promotion green -> defer 6c. Rollback is only clean if 6c deletions are NOT bundled with the 6a flip.

C1 [CRITICAL] — Before flipping the live queue, VERIFY matrix/umbrella check-name parity on the gh-readonly-queue/* branch. The 3 matrix contexts 'Ticket tests (linux-bash4/macos-bash3/alpine-busybox)' (names from matrix.name) and merge-pipeline-checks must match required-checks.txt byte-for-byte on the merge_group branch or every entry green-stalls. The ADR spike (#544/#545) used only a minimal check, NOT the real 13-context required set. Queue a throwaway PR and diff the Checks-tab names on the queue branch vs required-checks.txt.

C2 — make ci.yml 'Capture PR SHAs' step (merge-pipeline-checks) event-aware (fall back to github.event.merge_group.head_sha); today it reads null pull_request.*.sha on merge_group and is benign only by an empty-guard accident.

N1 — confirm a SEPARATE non-cancelling concurrency group for merge_group so an in-flight queue check isn't cancelled by a later PR push (amplifies eviction/regroup).

Verdict: trajectory SOUND, industry-aligned (LLM-on-sub-PR / deterministic-on-merge_group matches CodeRabbit/Claude/bors/Tide consensus); all 5 required workflows already carry merge_group triggers and merge-pipeline-checks has its merge_group arm.
